title: Oven Braised Spanish Pretzels Jamon Iberico
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Spanish dish featuring earthy and chewy pretzels, braised to perfection in a rich and savory sauce, inspired by the flavors of Jamon Iberico.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, sherry vinegar, and pretzels to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, braising for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the crumbled Manchego cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the dish with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
